campaign: Native RL GUI: recipe-selected DPO execution, bounded telemetry, and evidence views
doctrine: Follow skill.md. The GUI is a thin consumer of the same native training workflow as cmd/train. Active recipes, typed artifacts, trainingprogram, operation, runrecord, and RepoDB remain sole authorities. Add no DPO-only endpoint, shell execution, filesystem-path browser contract, duplicate orchestration, unbounded metric retention, smoothing, fitted curves, reward aliases, artificial thresholds, or extra model passes for visualization. Every wave migrates its production consumer immediately and deletes displaced logic.

items.title: Expose active DPO recipes through the existing training workspace and execute them through the native workflow

steps.title: Add typed artifact, dataset, checkpoint, and managed-output controls; bind a production workflow adapter without DPO-specific transport
steps.rationale: Recipe capability discovery must own form shape and admission. Browser fields carry identities, never arbitrary model or output paths.

items.title: Publish measured DPO observations without unbounded operation memory or duplicate model work

steps.title: Retain latest live metrics by name, stream step-bound observations to durable evidence, and report margins and optimizer health from existing traversals
steps.rationale: Long jobs cannot retain one in-memory metric object per step. Visual evidence must bind raw measured values to step, run, recipe, dataset, policy, and reference.

items.title: Render live and durable RL evidence in the existing training workspace

steps.title: Add signed raw-series plots, DPO margin decomposition, chosen/rejected pair inspection, optimizer health, checkpoint comparison, polling, cancellation, and artifact links
steps.rationale: The view explains preference separation and training health from existing measurements. It performs no scoring, smoothing, thresholding, or model-specific computation.
